description: This file declares classes and interfaces related to Dobby container management within the Thunder process container framework. It defines the DobbyContainer class, which implements container operations, and the DobbyContainerAdministrator class, which manages container lifecycle and IPC interactions.

classes.name: DobbyContainer
classes.description: Represents a Dobby container, providing methods to control and query container state.

classes.name: DobbyContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages Dobby containers, handles IPC, and maintains container lifecycle.

methods.name: DobbyContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing a Dobby container with specified parameters.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the container type, which is DOBBY.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with a command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container with a timeout.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory information of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the container administrator with a configuration.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance based on ID and search paths.

methods.name: DestroyContainer
methods.description: Removes a container by name, ensuring no leftovers.

methods.name: ContainerNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a container name is already in use.

methods.name: containerStopCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops, handling state changes.
